rule.title: Interest on loan proceeds not used to buy, build or improve the home is not home mortgage interest

when_missing.because: A mortgage on a home bought, built or improved it unless a preparer says the proceeds went elsewhere

citation.wording: Interest paid on home mortgage proceeds used for other purposes isn’t deductible on lines 8a or 8b.

rule.open_point: A loan whose proceeds were PARTLY used for the home is answered 'part' and stays counted as printed: the deductible share is Pub. 936's allocation, which the sheet does not compute. Interest on proceeds used for a business or investment may be deductible elsewhere; the excluded figure keeps its printed amount on the row.
